abstract: Investigation of developmental potential of various embryonal tissues is important for design of new approaches to regenerative medicine aimed at supplementing tissues damaged by trauma or disease. Rodent embryos have been extensively used in experiments designed for investigation of developmental potential to give rise to various types of epithelia such as superficial epithelia, neuroepithelium and sometimes even malignantly transformed epithelium in teratoma-like structures. These experiments have been done in vitro, in transplants in vivo and by combined in vitro-in vivo methods.
abstract_ja: 胚組織の多様な発生能を調べることは、外傷や疾患により損傷した組織を補う再生医療の新しい手法を設計するうえで重要である。齧歯類胚は、表層上皮や神経上皮などさまざまな種類の上皮を形成する発生能を調べる実験に広く用いられてきた。また、奇形腫様構造内で悪性に形質転換した上皮が生じることもある。これらの実験は、in vitro、in vivo移植、そして両者を組み合わせた方法で行われてきた。
